environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance in public subnet, exposed via Network Load Balancer (NLB) with TCP passthrough on port 443 terminated at the instance. Security group allows inbound 443/tcp from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request filtering or inspection layer. Instance runs Python 3.11 with Flask 2.3.x directly serving traffic via gunicorn.

config.load_balancer: NLB with TCP passthrough (no L7 inspection)
config.network: public subnet with IGW, no NAT gateway needed
